Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aseedah usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the prophet's grandsons and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Aseedah is a name with rich historical and cultural significance in Islamic tradition. It is the name of the honorary title given to the tribe of Hashim, which is the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) tribal lineage. The name Aseedah is a reminder of the Prophet's close connection to his ancestors and the importance of preserving the Prophet's family lineage and legacy.
